rows.grounds: compound of bali (offering) and dvaya (pair), object of kuryāt
injunctive prescription for the ritual act
indicates manner by reference to prior procedure
object of kuryāt, denoting the concluding act

items.question: In what manner must the pair of offerings, fire-oblation, and conclusion be performed?
premises: A pair of offerings is prescribed as a ritual element.
A fire-oblation is prescribed as a ritual element.
A concluding act is prescribed to complete the rite.
The manner of performance follows the previously described procedure.
items.inference: The practitioner should perform the pair of offerings, the fire-oblation, and the conclusion in the same manner as before.
items.plain_english: One should perform the pair of offerings, the fire-oblation, and the concluding act just as before.
